risks.risk: Repository main branch is observed unprotected in current GitHub metadata.
risks.treatment: No direct main mutation; candidate remains draft; G23/G24 execute against exact digest from a separate trust-root branch.

risks.risk: Repository rulesets are unavailable on the observed private-repository plan/API response.
risks.treatment: Enforce invariants inside workflows, frozen digests and explicit authorization; do not claim repository-level ruleset enforcement.

risks.risk: FFprobe provider is not pinned in toolchain lock.
risks.treatment: Audiovisual-validation claim excluded from framework certification until provider admission.

risks.risk: Human academic quality cannot be mechanically certified.
risks.treatment: Rubric criteria requiring disciplinary judgment remain G23/human obligations and block assignment-level certification.

risks.risk: AI or human writer may introduce unsupported claims or references.
risks.treatment: Writer has no certification authority; source ledger, citations, content review and G23 remain separate.

risks.risk: Citation metadata may be incomplete or unverifiable.
risks.treatment: Never synthesize absent DOI/author/page/URL; unknown or unverified citation identifiers fail closed.

risks.risk: DPI and pixel dimensions may be semantically conflated.
risks.treatment: Keep both concepts separate and preserve ambiguous source wording as UNKNOWN.

risks.risk: Malformed OOXML/PDF may pass superficial file-extension checks.
risks.treatment: Validate archive integrity, required parts/XML and PDF structural markers.
